bootstrap.pool: all done trade dates; one draw matrix for every statistic

K1.statistic: lower 95% bound of mean N_10(Topstep) = E_10 - 0.264 over fills with a valid 10 s markout, dropping and no-drop variants
K1.rule: holds if either bound is not above 0

K2.statistic: model (c) fills of the population, before any markout drop

K3.statistic: mean loop round trips per DAY trade date, model (c)

fragile_test.rule: a PASS is fragile if K1 would hold at 0.528 per fill

bootstrap.pool: trade dates on or after 2023-11-01 only
